name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: Fixed the Owner overview's mobile layout: the account menu could land near the left edge of the screen, causing its dropdown to open mostly off-screen. It's now pinned to its own row on the right, and the date picker/icons no longer feel cramped together.
The Owner overview can now look at any past date, not just today — pick a date and every company's card updates to show that day's deposits, withdrawals, Win/Loss and Store balance.
The Owner view now shows a clear "read-only" notice while looking at a company's dashboard, and a proper error if a save is ever blocked — instead of the screen quietly pretending it worked.
